# Read Primitives — Simple Limit

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Simple LIMIT without ORDER BY

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* LIMIT clause with ordering on large result set */
SELECT
  *
FROM lineitem
ORDER BY
  l_orderkey,
  l_linenumber
LIMIT 100
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def limit_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """SELECT * FROM lineitem ORDER BY l_orderkey, l_linenumber LIMIT 100."""
    return ctx.get_table("lineitem").sort(["l_orderkey", "l_linenumber"]).limit(100)
```

## Get the exact query for your run

The blocks above are representative. To get the precise statement a specific platform runs at a specific scale, substitute your own values:

